description.value: Blueberry Junction is a family-run blueberry farm on Huntingdon Road in Abbotsford that grows and sells its own Duke, Draper, and Liberty blueberries. They offer fresh berries in season, frozen berries year-round, and U-pick during harvest. The farm uses a reduced-spray program, applying only organic sprays from blossom through harvest in their designated fields.
